listen.description: Address the HTTP API listens on inside the container.

allowPublishedPort.description: false: a published host port on the sidecar container is the blocker api_exposed.

tokenFile.description: Operator-provided token file (for example a Compose secret); null: the sidecar generates the token.

sharedDir.description: A generated token is written to <sharedDir>/token.

tokenGroupId.description: Group of the generated token file (mode 0640, owner root).

dir.description: Holds status.json, backups/, releases/ and src/. Must be a volume.

service.description: The sidecar's own Compose service; null: its container label com.docker.compose.service.

projectDir.description: Host path of the Compose project, mounted at the same path inside the container. Required.

projectName.description: null: the sidecar's own label com.docker.compose.project.

files.description: Files passed as -f; empty: Compose's own discovery.

envFile.description: The interpolation env file Compose reads (the only file written).

profiles.description: Profiles passed as --profile to every Compose call.

registryAuthFile.description: Docker config.json with an auths object only, used for pulls and verification.

minFreeMb.description: Free space required on the state file system after the backup.

url.description: Repository URL, or the index URL for static; not used with file.

path.description: file only: directory with index.json, documents and bundles.

tokenFile.description: Token for a private repository, sent only to the feed origin.

allowPrivateNetwork.description: Allow loopback/private addresses for the feed host.

tagPattern.description: How a version maps to the Git tag.

checkIntervalHours.description: 0: the sidecar reads the feed only on request.

mode.description: keyless, key or none; never a fallback between them.

ciConfigPath.description: Path of the CI configuration in the project.

identityTemplate.description: Generic form: exact identity with {tag} and optional {version}.

trustedRootFile.description: Sigstore trusted root JSON for air-gapped hosts.

publicKeyFiles.description: PEM public keys; a signature by any of them is accepted.

transparencyLog.description: true: signatures must also have a transparency log entry.

acknowledgeUnsigned.description: Must be true with mode none.

isolate.description: Run cosign in an isolated sibling container.

workDir.description: Volume shared read-only with the verifier.

images.description: Optional mirror per image key of release.json.

repository.description: Mirror repository; signatures must have been copied (cosign copy).

imageVar.description: Env key the service takes its image from (a writable key).

stopBeforeUpdate.description: Stopped in the stop step (writers such as workers).

stopOnAttention.description: Stopped when the run ends in needs_attention.

optional.description: A release without this image key leaves the service as it is.

url.description: http(s) URL on the internal network.

type.description: A command in a service container.

service.description: Runs with docker compose exec -T in this service.

versionVar.description: Env key that receives the plain target version (a writable key).

redactKeyPattern.description: Values of matching env keys are registered for redaction.

user.description: null: the container's own env (POSTGRES_USER; MySQL: root).

flavor.description: MySQL family; auto: mariadb-dump if present, else mysqldump.

volumes.description: volume: Compose volume names (project prefix resolved).

quiesce.description: Stop before the backup (forced true for volume).

envKeys.description: Env keys whose values are passed to the backup container.

ageRecipients.description: age1... public keys; the verified backup is encrypted.

maxAgeDays.description: Older backups are deleted; 0: no age limit.

type.description: How the schema state is read before and after the update.

preset.description: Query of a migration tool (docs/hooks.md); exclusive with query.

query.description: One SELECT returning one value; exclusive with preset.

fingerprint.description: Append a hash of the schema catalog (columns) to the value.

jsonPath.description: Path of the value in the JSON body.

migrate.description: Optional separate migration run before the services start.

service.description: A managed service whose new image runs the command.

type.description: The app check; none gives the warning health_without_app_check.

url.description: http(s) URL on the internal network.

sendToken.description: Send Authorization: Bearer <token> (the app may reveal its version).

versionJsonPath.description: Path of the version in the JSON body; null: no version check.

conditions.description: { path, equals } pairs that must hold in the body.

service.description: Runs with docker compose exec -T; exit 0 is healthy.

versionFromStdout.description: The first line of stdout is the version.

afterGroup.description: Start group after which the app check runs first; null: the lowest.

versionMismatchLimit.description: Healthy answers with another version before health.version_mismatch.

waitForDockerHealth.description: auto: wait for healthy where a Docker healthcheck exists.

servicesGraceSeconds.description: For all managed services to be running after the last group.

checks.description: http or command checks after the app is healthy.

url.description: http(s) URL on the internal network.

type.description: A command in a service container.

service.description: Runs with docker compose exec -T in this service.

policy.description: null: probe when a migration probe is configured, else never.

allowlist.description: host or host/owner/repo, lowercase; empty: source mode off.

tokenFile.description: Token for the archive download; null: release.feed.tokenFile.

build.description: How each image key is built in source mode.

keepPreviousImages.description: Older images per repository kept besides the current and rollback image.

maxLeadSeconds.description: Latest start a request may ask for.

lateStartToleranceSeconds.description: A run found later than this after startsAt is not started.

composeSeconds.description: For config, ps, logs and inspect calls.

showVersions.description: Include versions in the public status.

templateDir.description: Replaces the built-in index.html and maintenance.css.

languages.description: Built-in: en, de; others need templateDir catalogs.

redactPatterns.description: Extra regular expressions whose matches are replaced by [redacted].

enabled.description: Report a newer sidecar release in GET /v1/state (never installs it).
